scientific_use: Exact DNA local similarity score for independent sequence pairs.
scientific_purpose: Exact DNA local similarity score for independent sequence pairs.
input_contract: pairs[B]=[DNA_A,DNA_B], A/C/G/T only, lengths0..128; match2,mismatch-1,linear gap-2
output_contract: B x signed32 optimal local score; no traceback or affine-gap claim
result_contract: B x signed32 optimal local score; no traceback or affine-gap claim
precision_requirements: Exact bounded integer arithmetic. 64-bit values are serialized as low/high uint32 words. Float inputs rejected; no implicit quantization.
validation_method: Entire output byte stream vs independent Python arbitrary-precision CPU reference; edge vectors before search; each timing candidate checked before/after; held-out winner confirmation.

licensing_provenance.implementation: Original ASTRO implementation of published equations; no external code copied.

RT_applicability: Dense reductions, recurrences or all-pair output have no useful ray/BVH candidate pruning.
scientific_scope: Stated primitive only. Generated test vectors validate algorithms, not researcher-authorized live jobs.

provenance.implementation: Original ASTRO implementation of published equations; no external code copied.

partition_limits: At most1,000,000 output records; spatial pair tests <=16,000,000 per job; RDF pair-bin tests <=16,000,000. Submit smaller tiles otherwise.
